persona: K-12 classroom teacher, any subject

beginnerNote: describe the event, get a professional flyer draft in seconds
pricingNote: Free plan includes AI credits (exact monthly allotment not detailed in this research pass); paid tiers available for more credits/branding - verify current pricing before publishing
accessNotes: General-purpose design tool with an explicit school-events use case listed by the vendor; no student data required for a generic fundraiser flyer

persona: Teacher who runs a private tutoring side business
title: Turn a teaching moment into a social media post to promote my tutoring business
workflowSummary: Tutor types a brief description of a teaching win, a common student mistake, or a study tip; the AI turns that short prompt into a ready-to-publish social media post, carousel, or short video with a caption, which the tutor reviews and posts to Instagram, LinkedIn, or Facebook.
samplePrompt: Turn this into an Instagram carousel: 'A student finally understood fractions today by comparing them to pizza slices' - include a caption and 3 tips parents can use at home.
beginnerNote: short prompt in, ready-to-publish post out, no design or video-editing skill needed
pricingNote: Free tier with roughly 15 AI-generated posts/month reported by one source; paid plans reported from about $19-$32/month (Core/Lite) up to $139-$249/month (Agency/Enterprise+) depending on source - pricing varies across listings, verify current tiers on predis.ai/pricing before publishing
accessNotes: General-purpose social media tool cited specifically for tutor marketing in this source; review AI-generated claims/testimonials for accuracy before posting, especially anything implying specific student results

persona: Teacher job-searching or building a professional online presence
title: Improve my LinkedIn profile to attract teaching job opportunities
workflowSummary: User connects or pastes their LinkedIn profile; the AI analyzes headline, summary, and experience sections against what recruiters and hiring managers look for, then generates specific suggestions to improve visibility and profile views.

beginnerNote: free automated review, specific actionable suggestions
pricingNote: Free AI-powered review tool per vendor page; broader Resume Worded resume tools have paid tiers - verify current pricing for any premium features before publishing
accessNotes: General-purpose career tool, not education-specific - fine for personal profile optimization; no student or district data involved

persona: Established Teachers Pay Teachers seller wanting more polished store visuals
title: Create eye-catching preview images for my Teachers Pay Teachers listing

pricingNote: Requires access to the creator's custom GPT (typically sold or bundled by the creator; exact current price not detailed in this research pass) plus a ChatGPT plan that supports custom GPTs - verify both before publishing

persona: K-12 music teacher (band, orchestra, choir, piano)
title: Generate practice exercises and sightreading material at my students' level
workflowSummary: Teacher describes the instrument, skill level, and technique to target (scales, a specific rhythm pattern, a piece's difficulty range); the AI generates notation-accurate sightreading exercises or method-style practice material, which the teacher can preview, play back, and export or share as a link with students.
samplePrompt: Generate 5 progressive sightreading exercises for beginner violin students focused on quarter and eighth notes in 4/4 time, in the key of D major.
beginnerNote: describe the technique and level, get playable notation back
pricingNote: Not detailed in this research pass - vendor page did not surface specific pricing; verify current tiers directly on noteshift.ai before publishing
accessNotes: General music-notation AI tool, not education-specific or FERPA-certified - fine for generic exercise generation with no student data involved

persona: World language teacher (Spanish, French, Mandarin, etc.)
title: Give my students extra speaking practice in the language they're learning
intentLabels: AI conversation partner for language learners
workflowSummary: Teacher assigns or recommends Langua as homework/supplement; students have open-ended or scenario-based spoken/typed conversations with an AI tutor calibrated to their proficiency level, receive corrections and vocabulary suggestions, and the teacher can choose tutor personas or topics tied to what's being taught in class.

beginnerNote: guided conversation modes, reply suggestions built in for beginners
pricingNote: Free account with a brief trial conversation, no credit card; unlocking unlimited practice requires a free trial (5 days monthly plan / 7 days annual plan) that does require a card; Standard plan reported around $12.50/month billed annually; school/institution plans are custom-priced

persona: School counselor or advisor delivering SEL instruction
title: Create a social-emotional learning (SEL) lesson for my students
workflowSummary: Counselor selects grade level (Pre-K through 12th), a CASEL competency (self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, relationship skills, responsible decision-making), and a specific skill focus; the AI generates a complete lesson with activities (discussion, role-play, mindfulness), materials list, timing, and optional cultural-responsiveness and assessment additions.
samplePrompt: Generate a 30-minute SEL lesson for 5th graders focused on conflict resolution under the CASEL relationship-skills competency, using a role-play activity and a short group discussion.
beginnerNote: guided dropdown selections, no prompt-writing needed
pricingNote: Not detailed in this research pass - verify current pricing directly on musely.ai before publishing
accessNotes: General AI tool suite (Musely also builds sports and other generators) rather than a counseling-specific platform - fine for lesson drafting; no student data required to generate a generic lesson

persona: Physical education (PE) teacher
title: Create a warm-up or full PE lesson activity for my class
workflowSummary: Teacher describes the class size, space/equipment constraints, and skill focus (e.g. a basketball unit warm-up for a mixed-ability class); the AI generates several activity or lesson options with progressions, which the teacher reviews and picks the best fit, then can pair with the same platform's rubric and differentiation tools.
samplePrompt: Generate 3 indoor warm-up game options for a Year 3-4 basketball unit, 28 students, some with limited mobility, that need no more than 5 minutes and minimal equipment.
beginnerNote: describe constraints, get several ready-to-use options
pricingNote: Free tier: start with 5 AI credits; paid upgrade for unlimited access to all tools/courses/features; department-level plans available with centralized billing
accessNotes: Purpose-built for PE teachers by PE teachers per vendor - no student data required for activity/warm-up generation

persona: School librarian or media specialist
title: Recommend the next book for a student based on what they've already read
intentLabels: AI book recommendation for school library
workflowSummary: Librarian connects the school's existing library catalogue; the AI analyzes over 30 factors per student (reading level, interests, favorite authors, curriculum topics, series progression) and generates a personalized reading list split into 'Challenge Reading' and 'Reading for Pleasure' sections, without needing to recatalogue the collection.
samplePrompt: Recommend the next 5 books for a 4th-grade student who loved the 'Percy Jackson' series and reads about a year above grade level, split between a challenge pick and books for pure enjoyment.
beginnerNote: setup requires connecting your catalogue, but recommendations are automatic after that
pricingNote: From £20/month per vendor page - verify current pricing and currency/region before publishing
accessNotes: Vendor states recommendations pull only from the school's own existing catalogue and apply age-appropriate content ratings, not just reading-difficulty matching - verify current data-handling terms before connecting a real student catalogue

persona: Teacher who also coaches a school sports team
title: Create a practice plan for my team
workflowSummary: Coach enters the sport, age/skill level, practice duration, and focus areas (conditioning, specific skills, game strategy); the tool generates a full, time-blocked practice plan with warm-up, drills, and cool-down, which the coach edits and shares with players or assistant coaches.
samplePrompt: Create a 90-minute high school JV soccer practice plan focused on passing accuracy and defensive shape, for a team of 20 players with cones and 10 balls available.
beginnerNote: guided fields, part of the same platform as other MagicSchool tools in this niche's research
pricingNote: Included in MagicSchool's free forever tier (80+ tools) and Plus tier ($12.99/mo or $8.33/mo annual) - same plan structure as other MagicSchool rows in this niche's research
accessNotes: Same vendor and free-tier terms as MagicSchool rows covered in the Session 1 batch (lesson plans, rubrics, report card comments) - this is a distinct tool (coaching, not classroom teaching), not a duplicate entry

persona: School principal or assistant principal
title: Turn my classroom walkthrough notes into written teacher feedback
workflowSummary: Principal takes notes (typed or via audio upload) during a 5-15 minute walkthrough or a longer formal observation; the AI turns those notes into structured, framework-aligned (e.g. Danielson) written feedback ready to edit and share with the teacher the same day, and tracks each teacher's growth across multiple visits over the year.
samplePrompt: Turn these walkthrough notes into Danielson-framework-aligned feedback for a 10-minute visit to a 7th-grade math class: strong use of think-pair-share, but three students were off-task during independent work with no redirection observed.
beginnerNote: paste or dictate notes, get structured feedback back in minutes
pricingNote: Free for individual principals to use
accessNotes: Vendor states notes are encrypted, accessible only to the principal, and not used to train third-party AI models; principals can delete notes or their account at any time - final written feedback and any personnel-record decisions remain the principal's judgment, not the AI's

persona: Paraprofessional, instructional aide, or related service provider on an IEP team
title: Collect and track progress data for the students I support
workflowSummary: Para or related service provider logs data (trials, frequency, duration, percentage accuracy, and other data types) for shared students directly in the app during the school day; the platform auto-generates graphs and progress reports the case manager can bring into IEP meetings, with the whole IEP team - not just the case manager - able to contribute data.
samplePrompt: Log today's data for this student's IEP goal on independent transitions between activities: 4 out of 6 successful transitions with no more than one verbal prompt each.
beginnerNote: built for quick, in-the-moment logging during the school day
pricingNote: Free plan covers unlimited students, standard data tracking, reports/graphs, scheduling, service time tracking, and para collaboration, with a 1-month trial of paid features; school/district/enterprise plans are custom-priced
accessNotes: Built for the full IEP team including paraprofessionals, not just the case manager - confirm with your district's special education office which data-collection tool is approved before entering real student names or goal data

persona: Online or virtual course teacher (asynchronous/flipped classroom)
title: Turn my recorded lesson video into an interactive lesson students can't just passively watch
workflowSummary: Teacher uploads an existing instructional video (their own recording or a curated video); PlayPosit lets them layer in questions and prompts at specific points in the video, turning it into a self-contained interactive lesson ('bulb') that pauses for student responses instead of playing straight through, suited to flipped classrooms and fully online courses.
samplePrompt: Take this 8-minute recorded lecture on the water cycle and add a multiple-choice check for understanding after each major concept, plus one open-response reflection question at the end.
beginnerNote: editing interaction points takes a bit of setup time the first time, but is quick after that
pricingNote: Not detailed in this research pass - verify current free-tier limits and paid pricing directly on the vendor site before publishing
accessNotes: General-purpose video-interactivity tool, not specific to any one LMS - confirm compatibility with your school's LMS before building a full course around it

persona: Career and Technical Education (CTE) instructor

workflowSummary: CTE instructor or program director inputs current industry standards and certification requirements for their pathway (e.g. graphic design, health sciences); the tool generates scaffolded worksheets, quizzes, and slide decks that stay aligned to those shifting standards, and can help a mentor teacher rapidly build materials for a newer colleague entering the same specialized field.

persona: First-year or early-career teacher going through district induction
title: Get coaching feedback on my own teaching between formal mentor visits
workflowSummary: New teacher uploads a video or audio recording of their own lesson; the AI guides them through a structured self-coaching conversation (based on an Analyze-Reflect-Enact-Impact cycle grounded in instructional coaching research) to set a goal, reflect on what happened, and identify a concrete next step - available any time, not just during scheduled mentor visits.

title: Plan curriculum across several grade levels or subjects I'm responsible for teaching
workflowSummary: Parent-teacher creates a class profile for each child (grade level, subject-by-subject level, e.g. 'Grade 2/reading above level, math on-grade'); the AI generates lesson plans, reading comprehension questions, science investigations, and assessments matched to each child's specific level, which co-op members can also use to generate materials in their own subject specialty for the group.
